title: VTG PORCELAIN DOLL - 1988 "KELLY" BEST FRIENDS LIMITED EDITION W/ CERTIFICATE
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1988 porcelain doll named "Kelly" from the Best Friends Limited Edition series. Kelly wears a limited edition Christmas costume and is imported for limited distribution through the AMC member stores throughout the world. It includes a certificate and features intricate details that are characteristic of porcelain dolls. This set is a collectible item that would appeal to doll collectors or enthusiasts of vintage dolls.
